name: Northwind support triage
request: Go through the support inbox, draft replies, check them against policy, and send nothing until I approve.

steps.prompt: Read northwind/support-inbox.md. Write northwind/support/triage.md: for each email, a category (damaged order, shipping question, billing/refund, product question, feedback) and urgency (high/normal/low).

Read northwind/company.md, northwind/support-inbox.md and northwind/support/triage.md. Write a reply to each email in northwind/support/drafts.md, in the voice from company.md. Don't promise anything company.md policies don't allow.

Read northwind/company.md and northwind/support/drafts.md. Check each reply against policy and voice (e.g. no health claims, correct shipping and refund rules). Fix problems in drafts.md and note any email a human should look at in northwind/support/flags.md.
Split the final drafts into one file per email in northwind/support/outbox/ (reply-1.md, reply-2.md, ...).
steps.asks: wants to queue the support replies for sending
